subject: Staged evaluation: success criteria, exit gates & close timeline
messages:
From: John Dalton <john.dalton@nimbushealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged evaluation: initial MAP outline and acceptance asks

Ava,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. As discussed with the evaluation committee, we want to lock down a clear, staged MAP and the acceptance tests so internal stakeholders can sign off. High level asks from our side:

- A concise set of success criteria for each stage (integration, pilot, scale).
- Concrete exit gates (what constitutes a pass / fail).
- Expected data/sync points for SOC2 and data residency checks.
- A suggested close timeline and decision points (we need this for procurement).

I've attached a working spreadsheet with our preferred milestone dates — please annotate with Redwood's acceptance tests.

Also looping in Procurement for timing on PO terms.

John
Nimbus Health

Attachment: Nimbus-MAP-staged-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: John Dalton <john.dalton@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged evaluation: initial MAP outline and acceptance asks

John — thanks for the notes and the sheet. Drafted a staged plan and included acceptance tests inline below. Attached is a filled copy of your spreadsheet and a short SLA proposal for procurement.

Summary (stages):
1) Integration (2 weeks) — objective: secure connectivity, auth, ingest pipeline, basic inference.
   - Success criteria: API connectivity validated from your dev VPC; keys rotateable via KMS; model loads for 2 example flows.
   - Exit gate (pass): 3 end-to-end test cases run (smoke) with OK responses and no PII leakage in logs.
   - Acceptance tests: automated postman collection (run id + logs), KV-cache correctness, sample latency report (p95 < 750ms).

2) Pilot (4 weeks) — objective: run representative traffic and validate quality and cost.
   - Success criteria: model outputs meet rubric (precision >= 85% on labeled set), sustained throughput target 50 req/s, latency p95 < 450ms for 512-token sequences.
   - Exit gate: quality panel sign-off (product and clinical reviewers) + cost per 1k tokens below agreed threshold.
   - Acceptance tests: evaluation harness (20 prompt families), regression alerts enabled, token accounting reconciliation.

3) Scale readiness (2 weeks) — objective: validate autoscaling, failover, and long-run telemetry.
   - Success criteria: autoscale to 200 req/s with <5% error rate; KV cache hit-rate > 60% for prefix cacheable flows; trace sampling shows no error spikes.
   - Exit gate: site reliability checklist green, SLA draft accepted by procurement.
   - Acceptance tests: load-run (72h), chaos-tested fallback to cheaper region, billing reconciliation test.

Commercial close recommendation:
- Target decision: 30 days from MAP start assuming pilot pass. If pilot shows >2 regressions on quality that require model changes, add a 2-week remediation window.

Attachments: Redwood_Markup_on_Nimbus-MAP-staged-v1.xlsx, redwood-sla-proposal-2026.pdf

Next steps: Karthik will scope the pilot engineering tasks and provide a runbook. Lauren will share a suggested contract amendment for the pilot phase. Can we lock an internal kickoff for Monday 8/2?

— Ava
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: John Dalton <john.dalton@nimbushealth.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged evaluation: initial MAP outline and acceptance asks

John / Ava — a few technical clarifications to make the acceptance tests executable from an SRE/inf-team perspective:

- Integration stage: We'll provide a short Postman collection + step-by-step VPC peering guide. API keys created for a sandbox project expire in 14 days by default (we can extend to 30 for the pilot).
- Data checks: For the "no PII in logs" exit gate, we'll provide a log-sampling script and an exported redaction report (sample attached).
- Quality rubric: propose a three-point rubric (Accuracy / Safety / Relevance) with numeric thresholds. I'll attach an example eval JSON and the harness commands.
- Load runs: we'll run a seeded 72h load from our staging cluster and provide the raw telemetry dashboard (token counts, latency, error traces).

Technical acceptance checklist (short):
- Auth: KMS-backed keys validated (yes/no)
- Connectivity: API calls from your dev VPC (ok/failed)
- Latency: p95 < 450ms for 512 tokens (pass/fail)
- Throughput: sustain 50 req/s for 1h target (pass/fail)
- Quality: labeled set score >= 85% (pass/fail)
- Billing: test invoice for pilot period reconciled (ok/needs review)

I'll join the Monday kickoff to walk the infra steps.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: soc2-extracts-sample.pdf (pdf, 230KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: John Dalton <john.dalton@nimbushealth.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged evaluation: initial MAP outline and acceptance asks

John — thanks, this is aligned with what procurement needs. A few commercial notes and timeline commitments: 

- Pilot SOW: we'll provide a 30-day pilot statement of work with capped usage. Draft SOW will be sent by EOD Friday.
- Credits: Because Nimbus is committing to an accelerated timeline, we can offer a one-time pilot credit equal to 25% of projected pilot usage (applied to the first invoice) — we will note this in the SOW.
- Decision milestone dates (proposed):
   * Kickoff: Mon 2026-08-02
   * Integration complete: 2026-08-16
   * Pilot end / quality review: 2026-09-13
   * Executive decision / commercial close: 2026-09-20

If the pilot fails an exit gate, the options are: 1) remediation window (2 weeks) with a focused root-cause plan; 2) mutual termination of the pilot with a small wrap fee to cover usage. We'll include both options in the SOW.

I'll send the SOW + draft amendment to your procurement contact and include the HubSpot deal link so we can track approvals.

Best,
Lauren
Head of Growth Operations
Redwood Inference
